tools.name: query_pol_certificates
tools.description: Query immutable ProofOfLogic certificates stored on Irys Datachain by DJZS Protocol. USE THIS TOOL when you need to verify audit history for an agent or project before delegating work, check FAIL verdicts, or retrieve certificates by Irys tx ID. DO NOT use for on-chain trust scores — use query_agent_trust for those.

targetSystem.description: Return only certificates whose Target-System tag equals this agent or project identifier (a project name or wallet address), matched exactly as written on the certificate

verdict.description: Return only certificates with this audit outcome

tier.description: Return only certificates carrying this tier tag

limit.description: Maximum number of certificates to return, newest first

from_ms.description: Start of the search window, as Unix time in milliseconds. When omitted the server searches the last 14 days, then the last 3 days if the wider search fails; set it to reach older certificates, and it is used as given

to_ms.description: End of the search window, as Unix time in milliseconds. When omitted it is one hour after the current time

tools.name: query_agent_trust
tools.description: Query an agent's DJZS trust score, aggregated on-chain (Base mainnet) from its audit history and indexed via the DJZS subgraph. USE BEFORE delegating work, releasing escrow, or executing agent transactions. Returns scored_audits, pass/fail counts, the raw fail rate, and a Wilson 95% lower bound on it, plus latest verdict/risk and DJZS-S01/DJZS-X01 flag counts. WAIT verdicts are abstentions: they are excluded from BOTH the numerator and the denominator of the fail rate and are reported separately as wait_count. Below 10 scored audits the tool returns INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY and NO rate - a 0-of-0 record is not evidence of reliability and must not compare as better than a 3-of-50. This tool returns evidence, not a decision: it applies no threshold and emits no HALT. Interpreting the bound against your own risk tolerance is the caller's job.

agentAddress.description: Wallet address of the agent whose audit record you want, such as a counterparty you are about to delegate work to or pay

tools.name: verify_pm_trade
tools.description: Deterministic pre-execution audit of a prediction-market trade thesis, run before capital is committed. USE THIS TOOL before opening, sizing, or increasing any prediction-market position, and whenever a user or an upstream agent asks whether a thesis is sound, carries a falsification condition, or has a sourced probability basis. Audits against the calibrated DJZS-M taxonomy (M01 narrative/resolution gap, M02 falsification absent, M03 probability unsourced, M04 consensus-as-edge advisory) and returns PASS->PROCEED, WAIT->HALT, or FAIL with the flagged defects and a reproducible verdict_hash. DO NOT use to retrieve past verdicts or certificates - use query_pol_certificates for those. DO NOT use for an agent's historical trust score - use query_agent_trust for that. DO NOT use for spot, perpetuals, or equities: out-of-scope submissions are refused WITHOUT CHARGE. Audit before act. Paid tool: 2 USDC per audit via x402 on Base.

intent.description: The prediction-market bet as the user or upstream agent stated it, in plain text: the market, the side, the reason, the probability and where it comes from, the size, and what would prove the bet wrong. Send the original wording; the audit judges only what is written

target_system.description: Agent or project name to record on the anchored certificate. It is stored ONLY when target_system_subject and target_system_signature are also sent and the signature verifies; otherwise it is DISCARDED, not stored

target_system_subject.description: Wallet address that signed the target_system claim; the server checks that target_system_signature recovers to it

target_system_signature.description: Signature by target_system_subject proving the claim: EIP-191 personal_sign over the text "DJZS-TSC-1 target-system claim\nsubject: <lowercased subject>\ntarget_system: <value>"

agent_address.description: Optional agent wallet (0x). If set, this audit updates that agent's on-chain DJZS trust score

tools.name: verify_perp_trade
tools.description: Deterministic pre-execution audit of a perpetual or spot TRADE thesis (direction, size, leverage, entry, stop, target, venue, and the REASON), run before capital is committed. USE THIS TOOL before opening, sizing, or increasing any perpetual or spot position. Returns PASS / WAIT / FAIL with a reproducible verdict hash. A position stated with no thesis FAILS (DJZS-S01); an unbounded position FAILS (DJZS-X01); an unresolvable stop or thesis WAITs. Prediction-market bets are refused here (use verify_pm_trade) and are not charged. Price 2.00 USDC per audit on Base.

intent.description: The trade as the user or upstream agent stated it, in plain text: instrument, direction, size, leverage, entry, stop, target, venue, and the reason the price should move that way. A position sent with no reason FAILS

bracket.description: Optional exact bracket (side, entry, stop, target, taker_fee_bps, optional hit_rate_pct / funding_rate_8h / sigma_annual). Returns the break-even hit rate in the non-scoring mechanics block; never enters the verdict or its hash

side.description: Direction of the position: long profits if price rises, short if it falls

entry.description: Planned entry price, in the instrument's quote currency

stop.description: Stop-loss price, in the same units as entry

target.description: Take-profit price, in the same units as entry

hit_rate_pct.description: The thesis's stated probability, in percent, that the target prints before the stop

taker_fee_bps.description: The venue's taker fee in basis points; the break-even calculation charges it on entry and again on exit

funding_rate_8h.description: Funding rate per 8-hour interval as a fraction (0.0001 means 0.01%); a positive rate is paid by longs. Used only when sigma_annual is also sent

sigma_annual.description: Annualized volatility as a fraction (0.45 = 45%); sets the expected hold, and so the funding paid

target_system.description: Agent or project name to record on the anchored certificate. It is stored ONLY when target_system_subject and target_system_signature are also sent and the signature verifies; otherwise it is DISCARDED, not stored

target_system_subject.description: Wallet address that signed the target_system claim; the server checks that target_system_signature recovers to it

target_system_signature.description: Signature by target_system_subject proving the claim: EIP-191 personal_sign over the text "DJZS-TSC-1 target-system claim\nsubject: <lowercased subject>\ntarget_system: <value>"

agent_address.description: Optional agent wallet (0x). If set, this audit updates that agent's on-chain DJZS trust score
